engine_requests.scope: New current generic version and new 1.2 version only; approved 1.1 and historical versions unchanged
engine_requests.request: For new generic versions, keep substantive atomic questions reachable for any aggregate answer. All substantive unknown is Not Assessed; affirmed substantive absence is Not Implemented; meaningful mixed/incomplete/unknown substantive facts or affirmative aggregate No/Partially contradiction are Partially Implemented. Every applicable source atom Yes with no material gap/unknown is Implemented even if the duplicate aggregate practice answer is Not sure; do not add a hidden confidence clause. Approved 1.1 and current 1.2 source process questions retain their separately reviewed semantics.

Remove inventory_dependency/detection comparisonConflict from implementation scoring; retain neighboring context read-only. Only process/frequency/actions are required criteria. Optional unanswered fields must not lower status.
Reject None or Not sure selected together with a permitted response; one permitted alternative is enough. Do not require all three responses or automatically approve exceptions.

Only source-conditioned atomic rows may accept Not applicable with explicit rationale. All excluded conditional rows mean insufficient implementation basis, not automatic whole-safeguard N/A. Whole N/A remains the existing authorized native applicability approval path.

Retain legacy unresolved wording as non-scoring context. Unresolved can refer to an open record after valid quarantine rather than a confirmed missed weekly addressing obligation. Confirm actual source requirement using authoritative weekly frequency/response answers or explicitly reviewed confirmed gaps; never silently turn optional Yes or blank into a hidden criterion.

Unknown aggregate plus every substantive atomic practice No is affirmed absence (Not Implemented). Unknown aggregate plus only some No and all remaining atoms unknown has insufficient overall basis (Not Assessed with known row gaps). Any meaningful atomic Yes/Partially or affirmative partial practice plus unresolved/unmet requirements is Partially Implemented.
